title: Contact readiness
idea: Contact readiness: Permission device token and test results stay separate
audience: People who need to verify readiness within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Recipients need to diagnose calling readiness
avoidWhen: A single green badge hides uncertainty
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its verify readiness priority and explicit commitment contract: Invitation acceptance never guarantees reachability
navigation: Contact readiness keeps the current verify readiness context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Permission device token and test results stay separate
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to verify readiness; recipients need to diagnose calling readiness

imagery.role: Support the actual verify readiness context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use a checklist with explicit last-tested timestamps
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the contact readiness structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no verify readiness content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Invitation acceptance never guarantees reachability
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized verify readiness content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active verify readiness context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
